safety.emergency_title: Get help now if anyone is in danger
safety.emergency_body: This may be an emergency. Call the emergency service first, and stay away from the hazard. File the civic complaint afterwards.
safety.urgent_body: This could cause harm soon. Report it quickly on the phone helpline, and warn others nearby.

hazard.live_wire: Fallen or exposed electric wire: keep away and do not touch it or water near it.
hazard.fire: Fire or smoke: move away and call the fire service.
hazard.gas_leak: Gas smell: do not switch on lights or flames; open windows and leave.
hazard.collapse: Building, wall or tree collapse: keep people away from the area.
hazard.injury: Someone is injured: call an ambulance.
hazard.flood_home: Water entering homes: move to a higher place and switch off the main power if safe.
hazard.open_manhole: Open manhole or pit: warn others and mark the spot if you can do it safely.
hazard.contaminated_drinking: Possibly contaminated drinking water: boil water before drinking or use another source.
